## What Kasshit is

Kasshit (also written KASSH.IT or Kasshit) is a technology and marketing company. We help businesses with:

- Artificial intelligence — AI agents, chatbots, voice agents, automation
- Software development — custom websites, web apps, dashboards, CRM/ERP
- Mobile app development — Android and cross-platform apps
- UI/UX design
- Cloud and DevOps — AWS, Azure, CI/CD
- Digital marketing — social media, content, SEO, Google Ads, Meta ads, branding

Technology and marketing under one roof. Clients across e-commerce, travel, education, and professional services.
